# cycle_stack_builds (Data Source)

Lists Cycle stack builds for a stack. Deleted builds are omitted. Set `state` to `live` to find builds that can be deployed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All builds for a stack.
data "cycle_stack_builds" "all" {
  stack_id = cycle_stack.demo.id
}

# Only live builds — useful when pointing a pipeline at an existing build
# instead of creating a new cycle_stack_build.
data "cycle_stack_builds" "live" {
  stack_id = cycle_stack.demo.id
  state    = "live"
}

output "latest_live_build_id" {
  value = try(data.cycle_stack_builds.live.builds[0].id, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stack_id` (String) The ID of the stack whose builds should be listed.

### Optional

- `state` (String) When set, only builds in this state are returned (for example `live`).

### Read-Only

- `builds` (Attributes List) The stack builds matching the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--builds))

<a id="nestedatt--builds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `builds`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The user-defined description of the build.
- `git_type` (String) The git ref type used for this build (`branch`, `tag`, or `commit`), if the build was created from git.
- `git_value` (String) The git branch, tag, or commit used for this build, if the build was created from git.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this build belongs to.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the stack build.
- `stack_id` (String) The ID of the stack this build belongs to.
- `state` (String) The current state of the build (for example `live`).
- `variables` (Map of String) Build-time variables supplied when the build was created.
- `version` (String) The version string from the build's `about.version` field.
